credit: Rustic olive fruit (Dynamic Trees tree-pack fruit block). Dynamic Trees ships its own fruit as static blockstate + block models (see dynamictrees:blockstates/apple.json); the Rustic olive and ironberry fruits are registered by Dynamic Trees at runtime under rustic:olives / rustic:ironberries, so their render assets must be authored here too - otherwise Minecraft falls back to a missing-texture cube. The legacy olive cluster sprite is drawn as a cutout cross so the fruit reads as a hanging cluster on the branch; the four growth ages share this one model (the per-age collision still grows, driven by trees/rustic/fruits/olives.json block_shapes).
